page_title: COM 1-1 CRE | Como v Cremonese 27/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Van der Brempt I. Thigh Injury

commentary.text: 90+7' Referee Marco Di Bello has finally had enough of Cesc Fabregas and gives him a straight RED CARD!
90+7' That's it for today, Marco Di Bello has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) picks up a yellow card.
90+3' Alvaro Morata (Como) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
90+1' Here is a change. Warren Bondo is going off and Davide Nicola gives the last tactical orders to Jeremy Sarmiento (Cremonese).
90+1' Here comes a substitution. Alvaro Morata (Como) is brought on as a substitute for Nico Paz.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.

90' Romano Floriani (Cremonese) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the roof of the net, but Jean Butez is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
89' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) meets a cross inside the box, but Jean Butez wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
87' Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
85' Romano Floriani (Cremonese) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Di Bello had an easy-decision to make.

84' Jayden Addai (Como) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes just wide of the right post. Terrific solo effort, though. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
84' Cremonese are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
83' Cesc Fabregas is stunned as referee Marco Di Bello shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
82' The referee shows a red card to Jesus Rodriguez (Como).

82' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Jesus Rodriguez (Como), but referee Marco Di Bello must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
81' Marco Di Bello blows his whistle. Jesus Rodriguez (Como) commits a foul after dangerous play.
80' Looks like Filippo Terracciano (Cremonese) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

79' Cremonese slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
77' We are about to witness a substitution. Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) is replacing Federico Bonazzoli.
75' Nico Paz (Como) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
75' Como work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

75' Stefan Posch (Como) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Como.
74' Como showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession. The linesman signals a throw-in for Cremonese.
72' Wonderful movement by Cremonese. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

69' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Federico Baschirotto (Cremonese) gets on the scoresheet after converting a chance from the resulting corner kick. He finds himself some space inside the box and plants a perfect header inside the left post. 1:1.
69' Franco Vazquez (Cremonese) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
67' Franco Vazquez (Cremonese) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

66' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat. The ball goes out for a corner. Cremonese can continue in their attacking effort.
66' Anastasios Douvikas goes off the pitch and Maxence Caqueret (Como) comes on.
64' Davide Nicola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese) replacing Dennis Johnsen.
64' Substitution. Martin Payero leaves the pitch and is replaced by Franco Vazquez (Cremonese).
62' The whistle blows and Martin Payero (Cremonese) is booked for an infringement.
61' Nico Paz (Como) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.

59' Romano Floriani (Cremonese) latches on to a precise cross on the edge of the box and strikes the ball goalwards. However, it goes just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
58' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.

56' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Cremonese are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
56' Romano Floriani (Cremonese) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
53' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) misses an absolute sitter after connecting with a cross inside the penalty box. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
53' Marco Di Bello interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Warren Bondo (Cremonese).

51' Cremonese slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
50' Como are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
47' Como quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) comes off for Romano Floriani.
46' Cesc Fabregas makes a switch. Jayden Addai is coming on in place of Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como) at the start of the second period.
46' The game is over for Jacobo Ramon (Como). Marc Oliver Kempf comes on for the second half.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Dennis Johnsen (Cremonese) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Nico Paz (Como) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
44' The Como players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
41' Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.
40' Cremonese keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
38' Como are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
37' What a save from Marco Silvestri! Jesus Rodriguez (Como) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
34' Jacobo Ramon (Como) has tested the patience of referee Marco Di Bello and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
32' 1 - 0 Nico Paz (Como) receives a well-taken defence-splitting low pass inside the box and scores! His great effort makes its way into the right side of the goal.
29' What was Maximo Perrone (Como) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
28' Alex Valle (Como) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Marco Silvestri.
27' Como seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
26' Nico Paz (Como) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
25' A long ball forward to Anastasios Douvikas (Como) is intercepted. The ball goes out of play and Como have been awarded a corner kick.
23' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.

22' A cross by Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
21' Cesc Fabregas is forced to make a change. Sergi Roberto is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Lucas Da Cunha (Como).
19' Sergi Roberto (Como) picks up an injury.

16' Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.
15' Cremonese can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

15' Dennis Johnsen (Cremonese) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. The ball goes out of play. Cremonese are awarded a corner kick.
13' Jacobo Ramon (Como) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Marco Di Bello blows for a foul.
10' Nico Paz (Como) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
9' Marco Di Bello shows a yellow card to Federico Baschirotto (Cremonese) for his blatant foul.
9' Federico Baschirotto (Cremonese) is penalised for holding. Marco Di Bello signals a set piece. A free kick is awarded to Como.

8' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) wastes an opportunity! He unleashed a strong shot from distance after the rebound fell at his feet. It went in the direction of the top left corner, but the goalkeeper pulled off a nice save to deny him.
7' Martin Payero (Cremonese) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
5' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
3' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
1' Wonderful movement by Como. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
1' The match has just started.
Cremonese will kick-off.
Marco Di Bello is the one to supervise the game today.
